case_studies.title: Case Study Title (optional - will use project title if empty)
case_studies.slug: case-study-slug (optional - will use project slug if empty)
case_studies.description: Brief description of the case study and what it covers

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Detailed content for the overview section. This should be comprehensive and well-formatted.
sections.context: Additional context information for this section (optional)

sections.title: Project Context
sections.content: Background information about the project, stakeholders, constraints, and initial requirements.

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.content: Details about user research, competitive analysis, stakeholder interviews, and discovery phase activities.

sections.title: Design Process
sections.content: Information about the design methodology, wireframes, prototypes, and design decisions.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.content: Technical implementation details, development approach, tools used, and challenges overcome.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.content: Measurable outcomes, user feedback, business impact, and success metrics.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Lessons learned, what would be done differently, and key takeaways from the project.

case_study.project_slug: String - Must match an existing project slug
case_study.title: String - Optional case study title (uses project title if empty)
case_study.slug: String - Optional slug (uses project slug if empty)
case_study.description: String - Brief description of the case study

section.title: String - Section title
section.content: String - Main content for the section (supports HTML)
section.media_urls: Array of strings - URLs to images/videos for this section
